verdict.rationale: Superset's docs describe a per-workspace Changes tab that shows exactly what the agent did. From that built-in diff viewer the developer stages, commits, pushes and clicks Create PR, so the PR exists only after the human has reviewed and chosen to create it. Diff lines can also be sent back to an agent as feedback. Missing for 10: an explicit approve/reject gate (approval is only implied by the manual Create PR step), independent hands-on corroboration of the review-then-PR flow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can review a diff of an agent's changes and approve it before it becomes a pull request
